findings.title: Instruction docs send agents to a backend contract the shipped code does not implement
findings.reason: Fact: AGENTS.md (L54) and README.md (L191, the wiring snippet its task 1 points to) document `POST /analyze`, and .qoder/rules/30-tasks.md (L9) repeats it, but backend/index.js (L153) serves only `/analyze/text` and src/services/api.js (L53) posts there. AGENTS.md (L9) states Expo SDK 52 while package.json pins expo ~54.0.0 with react 19.1.0 and react-native 0.81.5, and AGENTS.md plus .qoder/rules/00-project.md map 12 screens while src/screens holds 13. Inference: an agent that follows the documented snippet wires a call the shipped backend never serves, and dependency work proceeds from the wrong SDK generation. Owner: AGENTS.md, README.md, .qoder/rules/30-tasks.md, .qoder/rules/00-project.md. Uncertainty: the deployed Cloud Run service was not probed in this read-only review; the mismatch is between the inspected docs and the inspected code.
findings.aiFixPrompt:

Align the instruction owners with the shipped code. In AGENTS.md, README.md, .qoder/rules/30-tasks.md, and .qoder/rules/00-project.md: state the analyze endpoint as `POST /analyze/text` (src/services/api.js L53, backend/index.js L153), the stack as Expo ~54.0.0 per package.json, and the screen count as 13. Keep the retry-state requirement from 30-tasks.md and point it at the real route.

findings.title: The backend's only real verifiers are unreachable through any declared command
findings.reason: Fact: backend/package.json declares a single script, `test`, that echoes an error and exits 1 by construction. Two runnable verifiers exist — backend/eval.js (header: Usage: node backend/eval.js) and backend/verify-cascade.js (header: Run: node backend/verify-cascade.js) — but their invocations are documented only inside those file-header comments. backend/.env exists with no .env.example, so configuration requires reading the private .env, and AGENTS.md's verification section offers only npx expo start and the hex grep. Inference: an agent following the instruction owners cannot discover a runnable backend check, and the one declared test command deterministically fails, so backend changes ship unverified. Owner: backend/package.json scripts, AGENTS.md verification section. Uncertainty: eval.js and verify-cascade.js were not executed in this read-only review; their existence, headers, and the placeholder script are the evidence.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Wire the existing verifiers to the command surface. In backend/package.json, replace the placeholder test script and add scripts that run the invocations documented in the file headers: `node backend/eval.js` and `node backend/verify-cascade.js`. Add backend/.env.example listing only the variable names backend/index.js reads, with placeholder values — never copy real values from backend/.env.

## Validation

- Run each new npm script and confirm it produces its documented output (eval.js prints its confusion table; verify-cascade.js runs its four scenarios)
- Confirm backend/.env.example contains no real secret values
- Confirm `npm test` inside backend/ now routes to a real verifier instead of exiting 1

findings.title: The declared self-check gate false-flags 23 compliant lines and misses raw hex in App.js
findings.reason: Fact: .qoder/rules/40-self-check.md check 2 greps for Animated in src/screens and src/components and then drops every line containing the word reanimated, so compliant multi-line Reanimated imports report Animated on lines without that word — 23 hits across src/screens/VoiceScreen.js (L17), src/screens/VerdictScreen.js (L16), src/components/Overlays.js, and src/components/ThreatRing.js, all of which import Animated from react-native-reanimated. Check 1 greps only src/screens and src/components, while App.js (L36-37) carries two raw hex values (#F8F9FF, #1B4FD8) that the design law's token-only rule forbids. Inference: the gate fails compliant code, training agents to discount its output, and its scope blind spot passes real token violations, so a green run certifies nothing. Bounded context: Qoder session evidence observed 101 edit events with no later validation command in the analyzed sample, so no captured gate run contradicts this. Owner: .qoder/rules/40-self-check.md (and App.js for the hex). Uncertainty: none material — both defects reproduce deterministically from the declared commands.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Fix the declared gate and the violation it misses. In .qoder/rules/40-self-check.md, rewrite check 2 so it does not filter line-by-line: exclude files that import Animated from react-native-reanimated (the compliant pattern in VoiceScreen.js, VerdictScreen.js, Overlays.js, and ThreatRing.js) instead of excluding lines containing the word reanimated. Replace App.js's two raw hex values with the matching tokens from src/theme/tokens.js (#F8F9FF becomes COLORS.bg, #1B4FD8 becomes COLORS.primary), and extend check 1's scope to App.js so the blind spot cannot recur.

## Validation

- Re-run check 1 over src/screens, src/components, and App.js (excluding tokens.js) and confirm zero hits after the App.js fix
- Re-run the rewritten check 2 and confirm zero hits on the current codebase
- Boot `npx expo start` and confirm no red screen

findings.title: A failed backend verdict is indistinguishable from an offline one
findings.reason: Fact: src/services/api.js analyzeText() (L50-59) converts every backend failure to null via .catch(() => null), races the request against a 3-second stall, and returns the offline result whenever the backend loses, so a non-200, a timeout, a malformed response, and a stall all render exactly like a normal offline verdict. The backend's model_used field is consumed by no screen, and .qoder/rules/30-tasks.md (L20-21) requires the no-network, 5s-timeout, and non-200 cases to route to a retry state. Inference: neither an agent nor an operator can tell from the app whether the LLM cascade answered or the local rules did, backend regressions stay invisible on the core verdict path, and the documented retry state never triggers. Owner: src/services/api.js. Uncertainty: the deployed Cloud Run service was not probed; the claim comes from the inspected code path. The file header documents the behavior as intentional DEMO MODE, which bounds severity at Medium.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Make degradation observable on the verdict path in the smallest owned way. Have analyzeText() in src/services/api.js report which source produced the result (backend or offline), route non-200 and timeout failures to the retry state .qoder/rules/30-tasks.md already requires instead of silently returning the offline verdict, and surface the source — plus the backend's model_used when present — wherever the verdict is displayed.

## Validation

- With the backend unreachable (toggle the existing DEMO_MODE.offlineOnly flag in src/services/api.js), confirm the app visibly distinguishes the offline or retry state from a normal backend verdict
- Boot `npx expo start` and confirm no red screen
- Run the 40-self-check greps and confirm no raw hex or non-Reanimated Animated usage was introduced
